jobs_results.title: SOFTWARE ENGINEER - Dubai, UAE
jobs_results.description:
Starting salary of 60,000 USD per annum in a zero-tax environment.

Fast progression for strong performers.

Job location: Dubai, UAE

About us:

Cobblestone Energy is a proprietary trading firm that specializes in the wholesale electricity market across Europe. Electricity is fundamental to the world's economic activities. We trade enough electricity every day to power a small country, and in doing so, we help to address the mismatch between electricity generation and consumption.

Job description 

At Cobblestone Energy we are on a mission to build the most advanced European electricity trading and analytics platform, with our technology being used by our teams of commercial traders to create significant value. We are looking for enthusiastic and resourceful developers who are passionate about building exceptionally reliable and performance data processing solutions. You want to help the commercial team make data-informed decisions, have a curious mindset, and are motivated to... understand our business better. Developing a strong domain knowledge of our industry over time is key to long term success in this role. 

If you have excellent programming skills, strong problem-solving skills, and a passion for developing and improving applications utilizing cutting edge technologies, then we would like to meet you. 

What we offer in this role 
• Competitive remuneration, with fast progression for strong performers.
• A challenging but exciting, open, and fun work environment.
• An opportunity to work with remarkably talented colleagues.
• Vast growth potential in every aspect.
• 15% target bonus with further upside.
• Employee share scheme participation
• International relocation support
• Opportunity to be embedded within a commercial team for those with strong commercial interest

Responsibilities 
• Write software applications and programs for backend/frontend purposes. 
• Analyse programs and apps to improve their features and functionalities. 
• Test & debug programs and fix any reported bugs. 
• Collaborate with the tech team to improve the performance, efficiency, and scalability of our tools. 

Requirements 
• BS/BE in Computer Science/Computer Engineering. 
• Programming experience of 1 to 2 years in Python language. 
• Expertise in at least one popular Python framework (like Django, Flask ...). 
• Experience of 1 to 2 years in front-end technologies such as HTML5, CSS, JQuery, JS, ...etc. 
• Knowledge of APIs and webservices. 
• Knowledge of Relational Databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server ...) and SQL language. 
• Knowledge of NoSQL databases is a plus. 
• Knowledge of AWS is a plus / Knowledge of data visualization tools, mainly Tableau, is a plus. 
• Ability to work in a team environment. 
• Strong problem-solving skills and analytical skills. 
• Resilience and a determination to succeed. 
• Independent thinkers with growth mindset. 
• Must be passionate, self-motivated, and able to learn quickly. 
• Strong sense of integrity.  
• Personal values that match our company values

jobs_results.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
WHO WE ARE

At CoverWallet we are determined to revolutionize the insurance industry! We launched in 2015 and since then we are the leading digital platform for contracting insurance for small and medium-sized companies. Thanks to state-of-the-art technology and meticulous design we have turned insurance management and processing into a simple, fast and convenient process for our clients. All online, in minutes!

Our passion is in delivering innovation and value creation through technology, and our mission is to become the world’s leading InsurTech. For this, we have built an incredible team of ~800 people based in New York, Spain, Poland and Singapore. Success is guaranteed as we are part of Aon, the global leaders in risk, retirement and health solutions with 50,000 colleagues worldwide. We combine the mindset and culture of a high-growth startup with the backing and support of a global multinational. The best of both worlds in one company - what more could we ask for?

WHAT YOU... WILL DO

We are seeking an energetic and passionate Lead Software Engineer to join our fast-growing team in Spain. We are currently undergoing a transition to a new platform guided by Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles. You will be an integral part of one of our domain teams.

A TYPICAL DAY
• Collaborate closely with other frontend engineers to design, implement, and deploy frontend components for our product.
• Participate actively in code reviews, identifying and applying best practices for JavaScript
• Develop cost-effective solutions by deploying reusable capabilities, ensuring the product value is clear and justified, especially when addressing complex technical challenges.
• Play an active role in frontend-related recruitment activities, including interviewing and evaluating candidates.
• Serve as the focal point for the frontend guild.
• Collaborate with design, product, and business teams to iterate on the product using feature flags and experimentation.
• Establishing and managing Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for frontend systems.
• Drive the architectural vision for our front-end applications, ensuring scalability, performance, and maintainability.
• Stay current with front-end technologies, industry trends, and best practices to continually enhance our development processes.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED
• Proficiency in javascript (angular, react or view). Our stack includes: react + next + typescript.
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
• Proven track record of leading and mentoring a team of frontend developers.
• Demonstrated ability to influence and inspire cross-functional teams.
• Passion for building products that solve real-world problems and enhance user experiences.
• Strategic thinking with the ability to balance short-term solutions with long-term vision.
• Strong communication skills, collaboration abilities, adaptability, and a willingness to take initiative.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred).
• Previous experience in a leadership role within a JavaScript development team (preferred).
• English speaking and writing skills.
• Team player.

ABOUT THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS
• Your first contact with CoverWallet will be through an HR interview with one of our colleagues from the Talent Acquisition area, who will tell you everything about our company and its history, as well as the details of the position, functions, and your future conditions. We would love to know your professional and academic career, and of course, your motivations and expectations for a new professional project. We will be happy to answer all your questions!
• Do we have a match? Let’s move on to your First Technical Interview! You will meet two of your future colleagues from the tech area, who will explain to you in more detail what the team's day-to-day life is and its responsibilities. They will be very interested in expanding information about the role and company.
• If everything has gone well and you have impressed our colleagues, we advance to the Second Technical Interview! In line with the previous one, you will meet two other members of the tech team, who will continue to deepen your knowledge at the level of methodologies, roles, and previous projects, as well as about your background in our reference technological environments.
• If you've made it this far, things are getting interesting... It's time for your Final Interview! In this case, you will have the opportunity to meet one of our VP of Engineering, who will close the selection process with an interview aimed at getting to know you not only on a professional and technical level but also on a personal level, so that both of you can conclude whether the purpose of our project fits with your professional aspirations.

WHY COVERWALLET

At CoverWallet you will have the opportunity to be a key player in the transformation of one of the largest industries and in one of the most developed digital markets in the world. You will work in a cutting-edge tech environment, alongside a super powerful and diverse global team. Join us and build your own career plan in one of the world's leading companies, tailored to your dreams and aspirations! And just for good measure…
• Competitive salary based on your background and experience, and a variable annual bonus set according to your goals
• Enjoy flexible working hours and find out your ideal way of working thanks to our smart work model: full remote or hybrid, it’s up to you!
• Perks package consisting of a Company-paid Life, Accident Insurance and Medical Cover with free dental care. Complement your benefits with our flexible compensation plan (tickets restaurant, transport card, daycare checks, external training and even a Pension Scheme!)
• Carry on with your training thanks to your additional budget of 1,500€ per year to finance training courses, certifications, books or any teaching aids that will help you continue to grow professionally
• Enjoy a lot of offers and save on your purchases thanks to our discount platform (BigPocket) on your favorite brands (travel, fashion, technology, leisure...)
• 23 paid vacation days per year, plus 2 additional personal days and 2 wellbeing days to focus on your own health and prioritize self-care :)
• Great offices in Madrid, Valencia and Sevilla, where you will find all the coffee, drinks, snacks and fruit you want. Come and enjoy all the activities we do, both inside and outside the office (hackathons, meetups, tech talks, code katas and much more

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer C++/C
jobs_results.description:
We are One Team. We make it happen. We are Unstoppable.

BABEL es una consultora tecnológica multinacional especializada en aplicar sus servicios y conocimiento tecnológico en los procesos de aceleración digital de sus clientes, grandes empresas y organismos públicos.

Estamos buscando profesionales como tú que nos ayuden a llegar Marte 2025.

¿Qué es Marte 2025?

¡Es nuestro objetivo! Llegar a 5000 babelievers en el mundo, es el reto que tenemos por delante, y por ello necesitamos profesionales que nos aporten innovación, liderazgo y experiencia internacional.

¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos nuevos compañeros con experiencia en C/C++ para nuestros proyectos de desarrollo de software.

#Babel

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Babel es una compañía en un momento precioso de expansión, tenemos muchas oportunidades de desarrollo y un gran entorno de trabajo, basado en la colaboración y la solidaridad.

Trabajar en Babel es unirse a un equipo de personas con una misión compartida y a un modelo de compañía... centrado en valores.

Además,
• Apostamos por la flexibilidad laboral-personal. (Sistema de vacaciones por puntos, teletrabajo y flexibilidad).
• Invertimos en la formación de nuestros Babelievers.
• Invertimos en tu salud física y emocional. (Seguro Médico Privado/ Seguro de vida, entrenador personal y programa de wellbeing).
• Invertimos también en tu tiempo libre (Actividades en la naturaleza, campeonatos deportivos, suscripción a plataforma streaming (por Ej. Netflix)
• Participamos del crecimiento de la compañía y reconocemos la participación de cada persona (Bono de Beneficios).
• Ponemos foco en trabajar con últimas tecnologías y proyectos innovadores, pero sobre todo, acompañamos a la transformación digital y acercamos la tecnología a la sociedad.

¿Aceptas el desafío? ¡Te esperamos!

En cumplimiento de la normativa vigente en materia de protección de datos te informamos que el responsable de tus datos personales es GRUPO BABEL (consultar empresas en la política de privacidad), y los utilizará para gestionar tus procesos de selección, tanto actuales como futuros y el resto de finalidades descritas en la web. Este tratamiento está basado en el consentimiento del candidato. Los datos personales recabados no serán en ningún caso cedidos a terceros salvo por obligaciones legales expresas. Puedes ejercer los derechos que te asisten sobre protección de datos en la dirección data.protection@babelgroup.com. Toda la información sobre política de privacidad en nuestra web

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer (Python)
jobs_results.description:
Our mission is to build the most complete and reliable music consumption database for our clients—from record labels to music publishers and music industry associations.

As a software engineer, you will contribute to designing and developing the applications and systems that make our mission a reality. We receive more than 50M records every day from the most popular music streaming services which we need to process, consolidate, and aggregate before we show meaningful and actionable data in the products we build for our clients and partners.

We're looking for an experienced engineer with a track record of building and maintaining scalable and extendable applications. Previous experience in the music business is a plus. A strong belief that music can save the world is a must.

Our stack
• Python (Flask with GraphQL) for our backend
• MongoDB is our main database
• RabbitMQ with Celery for asynchronous tasks
• Jenkins for ci/cd
• Kubernetes to deploy our code
• AWS as the... infrastructure provider

Requirements
• 4 years of experience as a software engineer
• Strong knowledge of python
• Strong knowledge of MongoDB
• Experienced designing distributed systems, queues, caches, etc
• Strong knowledge of UNIX
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• You are a great mentor and enjoy helping less experienced colleagues grow.

It's a plus
• Experience with Flask and GraphQL
• Experience with Kubernetes

Interview Process
• Screening call with the People team
• Take-home assignment: complete a technical test
• Technical interview
• Interview with the team manager to discuss the project

Benefits

You Can Enjoy
• Flexible working hours and location
• Flat hierarchy
• You can make the role your own and run your own development
• Online language classes to improve your Spanish or English
• Online and onsite courses and music industry workshops run by inhouse experts
• We'll provide you with all equipment needed for you to be comfortable
• Unlimited time off because we believe that you know best when you need to rest
• Barcelona HQ office available to you, kitted out with a rehearsal room https://www.bmat.com/bmat-house/

Who The FAQ Are BMAT

BMAT started in 2005 when a group of engineers with a passion for music decided to spin-off from an audio research lab in Barcelona. We're now over 160 people, spread across Barcelona, Buenos Aires, Lima, Rio de Janeiro, London, Paris, New Jersey, Oslo, LA, Singapore, Tokyo, Manila, Bangkok and Lagos.

We're a team of pretty decent people who enjoy working with each other. We're open-minded and well-traveled, coming from all parts of the world. We've got rappers, producers, cello players, DJs, and songwriters. The passion for music and the excitement for innovative technology have proven to make a good combination.

BMAT has grown as a company of companies. Within BMAT there are a number of products and services that developed semi autonomously for different players - Digital Service Providers, Publishers and Collective Management Organisations.

Diverse perspectives drive innovation, and innovation is kind of our thing. Our open-minded and flexible culture organically fosters this diversity. We've learnt that we thrive on learning from each other, so we don't just welcome but actively hire a range of open-minded people from all walks of life. Our team is made up of people with different backgrounds, perspectives, orientations, abilities, musical tastes, dress sense and time-zones - but we all have one common goal: Making the music world a better place. With equal opportunities for everyone, BMAT is a pretty nice place to work

¿NOS CONOCES?

Lantek es una multinacional de soluciones software dirigidas al sector industrial, enfocada en la Industria 4.0 y en la transformación digital. Con más de 300 profesionales repartidos por todo el mundo, contamos con una gran presencia tanto a nivel nacional como internacional con oficinas en más de 15 países. En Lantek queremos transformar la industria, incorporando la última tecnología para mejorar y optimizar sus procesos.

¿QUÉ BUSCAMOS?

Estamos buscando personas a las que les apasionen los retos y que quieran formar parte de un proyecto de futuro. Personas comprometidas, innovadoras, proactivas y con vocación de servicio y

trabajo en equipo.

Descripción

Formarás parte del equipo de I+D en Lantek, involucrado en todo el ciclo de diseño, desarrollo, QA y deployment de los productos.

¿QUÉ NECESITAMOS DE TI?

Para cubrir esta posición pensamos en un perfil con:
• Formación técnica en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones y/o disciplinas afines.
• Experiencia... en desarrollo de software en lenguajes de programación C/C++, C# y/o JAVA, preferiblemente en aplicaciones para entornos industriales.
• Nivel alto de inglés.
• Capacidad para ser perseverante, trabajar en equipo y tener amplia curiosidad por el aprendizaje y la formación continua.

¿QUÉ OFRECEMOS?
• Contrato indefinido.
• Formato de trabajo híbrido.
• Flexibilidad horaria.
• Trabajar en una empresa referente en su sector que apuesta por la innovación de manera constante.
• Formar parte de un equipo de trabajo dinámico y altamente cualificado.

Si quieres incorporarte a una corporación dinámica y en un periodo de fuerte expansión, dentro de un sector con gran potencial de desarrollo a nivel global que ¡aquí tienes tu mejor oportunidad! ¡Te esperamos!

Aviso Legal: El responsable del tratamiento de sus datos personales es Lantek Sheet Metal Solutions, S.L.U con CIF B-01395698. Sus datos personales serán recogidos y tratados conforme a toda la normativa aplicable y en concreto al GDPR 2016/679 y a la Ley Orgánica 3/2018 de 5 de diciembre. Sus datos personales serán recogidos con la finalidad de evaluar su solicitud para el proceso de selección y serán conservados durante los plazos legalmente establecidos. Le recordamos que puede ejercer sus derechos de acceso, rectificación, supresión, limitación del tratamiento y portabilidad dirigiéndose por escrito a dpo@lantek.com. También le informamos que sus datos no serán objeto de decisiones individuales automatizadas ni de transferencias a países fuera del EEE. Para más información puede consultar nuestra política de privacidad en https://www.lantek.com/es/aviso-legal

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer IC3/IC4
jobs_results.description:
Mercury Mission Systems International Is Looking For a New Talent To Join Its Systems & Software Team In Getafe. We Are Looking For a

SENIOR EMBEDDED SOFTWARE ENGINEER

In cooperation with the Program Manager and the Software Manager, you will be supporting our software development and certification activities of complex high-performance safety and mission critical avionics and defense computers. You will be responsible for various software lead and development tasks.

Position Summary
• The Senior embedded softer engineer as member of the software design group, is responsible of the software high-level specification, architecture, and detailed design of the entire software items embedded into new avionics computer developed by MMSI.
• She/he takes parts to the project/ program life cycle as software functional leader managing all software activities.
• She/he is conducting all the technical analysis necessary to produce a design which meets customer and internal requirements... constraints in terms of functions, safety, performances, verification, industrialization, production, on-time, and on-cost.
• She/he is producing all the evidence and documentation in accordance with MMSI development process.
• She/he is conducting all the activities defined within MMSI integral process required by the product development life cycle (validation, configuration Management, checklists, problem reports, etc.)
• She/he is supporting the integration, validation, verification, and qualification activities as SW technical authority.
• She/is defining work package to be outsourced and following up suppliers.

Responsibilities
• Functional lead of software activities on highly complex avionic projects
• Establish and follow up software planning of the project.
• Coordinate with internal teams the different software activities of the project as well as the various milestones
• Ensure the software project execution is conform to the defined process.
• Participate to the specification, design, development, or verification activities when required.
• Develop and integrate software modules in C/C++, such as kernel drivers for Linux kernel, drivers for Certifiable RTOS (VxWorks 653, PikeOS, etc.), application software for system qualification or script for verification and testing tools.
• She/he participating to the transversal peer reviews as software expert.
• Software technical interface with customer or certification authorities
• The SW Functional leader has cross-functional skill, and capabilities to communicate with expert team, of other discipline (System, Hardware, FPGA, Safety)

Skills And Experience
• Master's degree in Information Technology electronics/computer science, or similar
• At least 7 years of industrial experience as embedded software engineer
• Fluent in Spanish and English
• Excellent programming skills in C/C++ and Python
• Proven background/experience in avionic safety critical software development life cycle (DO-178C)
• Proven background/experience in software project management (tasks definition, Workload evaluation, planning setup, tracking and monitoring, etc.)
• Technical knowledge/ experience in some of the following field is highly desired
• Certifiable RTOS and/or Linux kernel driver, as well as in application developments
• External stakeholder/ Outsourcing management
• Embedded Cyber-security (ED-203 / DO-356)
• Strong analytical ability.
• Ability to communicate effectively, both written and orally, with customers and at all organization levels.
• Leadership and ability to interact with multi-disciplined professionals to understand and make necessary trade-offs and decisions.
• High resilience and ability to work in a challenging and very dynamic environment

Why should you join Mercury Systems?

Mercury Systems is leading Commercial Provider of secure sensor and mission processing subsystems. We are pioneering a next generation defense electronics business model specifically designed to meet the current industry's current and emerging technology needs. The size and makeup of our organization enable forward thinking, entrepreneurial professionals thrive and prosper.

Mercury Mission Systems International SA (MMSI) Headquarters are, based in Geneva (CH), with branches in Getafe (SP), and Silchester (UK). MMSI is part of Mercury Systems, and is specialized in the design, manufacturing and maintenance of complex high-performance safety and mission critical avionics and defense computers.

Our Culture

We are committed to making Mercury a great place to work, no matter where our employees are located. We offer a casual and enjoyable atmosphere that allows employees to learn and grow. We help and care for one another and work as one to achieve results for us and for our customers. We value communication and transparency and strive to foster two-way dialogue at all levels of the organization. We are committed to lifelong learning, offering comprehensive skills training and tuition reimbursement. Whether you're just starting out on your career journey, or you are an experienced professional, it's important to us that you feel recognized and rewarded for your contributions.

Details
• Occupancy 100%
• Beginning of the activity ASAP
• Location Getafe (Madrid) Spain

We offer the opportunity to join a highly qualified and motivated team and the possibility to work in an international environment.

Why should you join Mercury Systems?

Mercury Systems is a technology company that makes the world a safer, more secure place. We push processing power to the tactical edge, making the latest commercial technologies profoundly more accessible for today's most challenging aerospace and defense missions. From silicon to system scale, Mercury enables customers to accelerate innovation and turn data into decision superiority. Headquartered in Andover, Massachusetts, Mercury employs more than 2,300 people in 24 locations worldwide. To learn more, visit mrcy.com

Our Culture

We are committed to making Mercury a great place to work, no matter where our employees are located. We offer a casual and enjoyable atmosphere that allows employees to learn and grow. We help and care for one another and work as one to achieve results for us and for our customers. We value communication and transparency, and strive to foster two-way dialogue at all levels of the organization. We are committed to lifelong learning, offering comprehensive skills training and tuition reimbursement. Whether you're just starting out on your career journey or you are an experienced professional, it's important to us that you feel recognized and rewarded for your contributions.

To find out more about Why Mercury?, or visit the Mercury Community or find answers to general questions at Mercury FAQs

Mercury Systems is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, creed, citizenship, disability, protected veteran or marital status.

As an equal opportunity employer, Mercury Systems is committed to a diverse workforce. In order to ensure reasonable accommodation for individuals protected by Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Veterans' Readjustment Act of 1974, and Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact the number below.

(978) 256-1300

jobs_results.title: Java Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

MultiSafepay is a cutting-edge fintech company that has been revolutionizing the payment industry for over two decades. As a leading Payment Service Provider, we specialize in developing innovative in-house solutions for a diverse range of merchants. Recognized as the top-ranked company in the "Emerce 100" Payment Service Provider category, we provide seamless and secure payment experiences for our clients. Join our dynamic team at our international office in beautiful Estepona, Málaga, and be a part of our journey towards global success.

As a Java Software Engineer at MultiSafepay, you will play a vital role in our Development team, working on building cutting-edge microservices in Java. You will have the opportunity to contribute to the migration of existing systems from Perl to Java, making our platform more robust and less dependent on legacy technologies. This is an exciting opportunity for a skilled Java developer to join a dynamic team, collaborate on... challenging projects, and shape the future of our fintech solutions.

Responsibilities
• Develop back-end applications using Java to ensure the smooth operation of our payment gateways and data processing systems.
• Implement and optimize payment gateways API to facilitate secure and seamless transactions.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features and functionalities.
• Perform data parsing and processing tasks to ensure accurate and timely information.
• Debug and fix issues in existing systems to maintain the stability and performance of our platform.
• Participate in code and design reviews to uphold the quality standards and best practices.
• Stay up-to-date with the latest technologies and industry trends to drive innovation and enhance our products.

Job requirements

Requirements
• Proven work experience as a Java Software Engineer, with a strong understanding of Java programming language.
• Minimum of 2 years of experience with SQL, preferably PostgreSQL.
• Basic knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems.
• Proficiency in version control systems, particularly Git.
• Experience with automated testing, including unit and functional testing.
• Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written, as we operate in a multi-language environment.

Who We Are: At MultiSafepay, we are a team of passionate professionals who strive for excellence. We value a collaborative and inclusive working environment, where every team member's input is respected and appreciated. Our culture is characterized by . We believe in continuous learning and offer opportunities for professional growth, along with a competitive salary package and health insurance benefits. Located near the beautiful beach of El Saladillo, our modern office provides a dynamic atmosphere with opportunities for cross-training and extra-office activities like gym access and free Spanish classes.

Ready to Join? If you are a Java developer who thrives on exciting challenges and wants to make a significant impact in the fintech industry, MultiSafepay is the place for you. We encourage you to apply and become a valuable member of our team. Help us shape the future of international payment solutions and grow both personally and professionally.

Benefits
• Long term work contract
• Competitive salary based on your skills and experience
• Health insurance
• Great challenges making our products more suitable for international presence
• A modern, dynamic working environment where we believe in working hard and rewarding effort
• Room for personal input and ideas, and professional growth
• Training support to improve your professional skills
• Office in a great location near the beach of El Saladillo
• Free Spanish classes and extra-office activities (cross-training, gym, etc.)

Apply Today: To apply, please submit your resume and a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and passion for Java development. Let's make a difference together

Job Description

MultiSafepay is a cutting-edge fintech company that has been revolutionizing the payment industry for over two decades. As a leading Payment Service Provider, we specialize in developing innovative in-house solutions for a diverse range of merchants. Recognized as the top-ranked company in the "Emerce 100" Payment Service Provider category, we provide seamless and secure payment experiences for our clients. Join our dynamic team at our international office in beautiful Estepona, Málaga, and be a part of our journey towards global success.

As a Java Software Engineer at MultiSafepay, you will play a vital role in our Development team, working on building cutting-edge microservices in Java. You will have the opportunity to contribute to the migration of existing systems from Perl to Java, making our platform more robust and less dependent on legacy technologies. This is an exciting opportunity for a skilled Java developer to join a dynamic team, collaborate on... challenging projects, and shape the future of our fintech solutions.

Responsibilities
• Develop back-end applications using Java to ensure the smooth operation of our payment gateways and data processing systems.
• Implement and optimize payment gateways API to facilitate secure and seamless transactions.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features and functionalities.
• Perform data parsing and processing tasks to ensure accurate and timely information.
• Debug and fix issues in existing systems to maintain the stability and performance of our platform.
• Participate in code and design reviews to uphold the quality standards and best practices.
• Stay up-to-date with the latest technologies and industry trends to drive innovation and enhance our products.

Job requirements

Requirements
• Proven work experience as a Java Software Engineer, with a strong understanding of Java programming language.
• Minimum of 2 years of experience with SQL, preferably PostgreSQL.
• Basic knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems.
• Proficiency in version control systems, particularly Git.
• Experience with automated testing, including unit and functional testing.
• Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written, as we operate in a multi-language environment.

Who We Are: At MultiSafepay, we are a team of passionate professionals who strive for excellence. We value a collaborative and inclusive working environment, where every team member's input is respected and appreciated. Our culture is characterized by . We believe in continuous learning and offer opportunities for professional growth, along with a competitive salary package and health insurance benefits. Located near the beautiful beach of El Saladillo, our modern office provides a dynamic atmosphere with opportunities for cross-training and extra-office activities like gym access and free Spanish classes.

Ready to Join? If you are a Java developer who thrives on exciting challenges and wants to make a significant impact in the fintech industry, MultiSafepay is the place for you. We encourage you to apply and become a valuable member of our team. Help us shape the future of international payment solutions and grow both personally and professionally.

Benefits
• Long term work contract
• Competitive salary based on your skills and experience
• Health insurance
• Great challenges making our products more suitable for international presence
• A modern, dynamic working environment where we believe in working hard and rewarding effort
• Room for personal input and ideas, and professional growth
• Training support to improve your professional skills
• Office in a great location near the beach of El Saladillo
• Free Spanish classes and extra-office activities (cross-training, gym, etc.)

Apply Today: To apply, please submit your resume and a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and passion for Java development. Let's make a difference together
